Multiple locations across Central Texas. Para el directorio, recomiendo no usar una sola dirección porque los servicios varían por clínica. Tiene ubicaciones en Austin, Bastrop, Cedar Park, Georgetown y otras comunidades de Central Texas. La ubicación más conveniente debe confirmarse según el servicio que la persona necesita.
Cost: Costs vary by service and insurance coverage. Medicaid, Medicare, CHIP, MAP and many insurance plans are accepted. Uninsured patients may qualify for discounted fees based on household income and family size. No patient is denied services because of an inability to pay.
Importante: Este es un recurso especialmente valioso para PuenteATX porque no requiere seguro médico y no restringe la atención según ingresos o lugar de residencia. Sin embargo, no todos los servicios están disponibles en todas las clínicas. Al referir a una familia, se recomienda llamar primero y especificar el servicio que necesita para identificar la ubicación correcta. Para familias sin seguro, el personal puede realizar una evaluación financiera y ayudar con solicitudes de programas de asistencia médica.

Information was confirmed through Manor ISD’s official Project Hope/McKinney-Vento page. The district currently lists Hilda Torres-Salazar as the McKinney-Vento Education Liaison and Veronica Rivera Santos as the McKinney-Vento Liaison Assistant, with dedicated phone numbers and email contacts. The page provides a referral process and links to a Spanish-language community resource guide. Spanish-language service delivery by program staff is not explicitly confirmed, so languages should remain listed as English only until separately verified. No dedicated walk-in service address is listed; the district’s main administrative address was not confirmed as a service location, so the address field is left blank.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX [location-review: variable]

LTISD Community Programs offers a variety of programs across multiple campuses. Extended Care is available at all seven elementary campuses, while the Child Development Centers are located at Lake Pointe Elementary and Lake Travis Elementary. There is no single service address; the appropriate address should be listed based on the specific campus.

For the 2026–2027 school year, Extended Care costs $220 per month or $30 per day for drop-in care, plus a $50 annual registration fee per student. Registration and payments are currently managed through Arux.

This is a paid resource and, on its own, does not appear to meet PuenteATX’s primary criteria of free or low-cost services. It would be helpful to verify whether financial assistance, subsidies, scholarships, or reduced fees are available. [location-review: variable]
